skill.name: sent-templates
skill.description: Finds, lists, inspects, and deletes existing Sent templates through Sent MCP tools. It filters by language, channel, category, status, name, or identifier. Separate skills handle WhatsApp content authoring and template interface design.
skill.summary: Find, inspect, and safely delete existing Sent message templates.
skill.author: sentdm

content.value_statement: Finding the correct Sent template across languages, channels, and organizations can be difficult. This skill discovers, inspects, and safely deletes exact template records.
actual_capabilities: Lists existing templates with filters and pagination.
Retrieves an exact template by identifier.
Finds templates by name and resolves ambiguous matches.
Reports template language, channel, category, status, and scope.
Deletes one verified template after explicit confirmation.
limitations: Requires an authorized Sent connection with the correct organization scope.
Does not create, edit, write, or classify template content.
Cannot safely delete a template when the target or scope remains ambiguous.
Does not automatically retry an uncertain deletion result.

use_cases.title: Find approved campaign templates
use_cases.description: Filter existing templates by status, language, channel, or category before selecting one.

use_cases.title: Inspect a template record
use_cases.description: Retrieve one template by name or identifier and review its metadata and current status.

use_cases.title: Remove an obsolete template
use_cases.description: Verify the organization, Sender Profile, and exact record before confirming a destructive deletion.

prompt_templates.title: List templates
prompt_templates.prompt: List my approved English templates. Show names, identifiers, channels, categories, and statuses.

prompt_templates.title: Find by name
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the template named {template_name}. Show separate matches for each language, channel, and organization scope.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve a template name that may be ambiguous

prompt_templates.title: Inspect an exact record
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect template {template_id}. Report its organization, Sender Profile, language, channel, category, and status without repeating unnecessary body content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review detailed metadata while limiting content exposure

prompt_templates.title: Delete a verified template
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare to delete template {template_name}. Fetch the exact record, show the required preview, and ask for fresh confirmation before deletion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced destructive workflow with scope and confirmation controls

output_examples.output: Found 12 matching templates. The first page shows each name, identifier, category, language, channel, and approval status.
Three records share that name. Select the English WhatsApp, Spanish WhatsApp, or English SMS record before continuing.
Deletion preview: template tpl_248 in the selected organization and Sender Profile. Confirm deletion of this exact record to continue.

best_practices: Verify the active organization and Sender Profile before any deletion.
Resolve names to one exact language, channel, and scope before continuing.
Request fresh explicit confirmation immediately before every deletion attempt.
anti_patterns: Do not delete from a guessed identifier, broad filter, or stale list result.
Do not treat earlier or general approval as deletion confirmation.
Do not expose credentials or repeat template bodies and sample data unnecessarily.

faq.question: Can this skill create a new template?
faq.answer: No. It manages existing records. Use waba-template-author for content and template-builder-ui for a creation interface.

faq.question: Can it find a template by name?
faq.answer: Yes. It presents separate candidates when language, channel, or scope makes the name ambiguous.

faq.question: What template details can it show?
faq.answer: It can show identifiers, names, languages, channels, categories, statuses, organization scope, and Sender Profile.

faq.question: Does deletion require confirmation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill fetches the exact target, shows a preview, and requires immediate explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Will it retry a failed deletion automatically?
faq.answer: No. Every retry requires a fresh target fetch, preview, and explicit confirmation.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: The client manages OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. The skill must never request or expose credentials.
